password_manager.label: a password manager
password_manager.needs: read and fill sign-in forms on any site, answer HTTP authentication prompts, and talk to its desktop app
password_manager.evidence: Verified against bitwarden/clients apps/browser/src/manifest.v3.json, which declares webRequest, webRequestAuthProvider and host access to http/https.

content_blocker.label: a content blocker
content_blocker.needs: see requests on any site to block them, and restyle pages to hide what is left

privacy.label: a tracker blocker
privacy.needs: see requests on any site, clear tracking cookies, and adjust pages

wallet.label: a crypto wallet
wallet.needs: add its wallet interface to any site that asks for one

developer_tool.label: a developer tool
developer_tool.needs: inspect and modify pages you are building

keyboard_navigation.label: a keyboard navigation tool
keyboard_navigation.needs: take key presses on any page

writing_assistant.label: a writing assistant
writing_assistant.needs: read and correct text as you type it anywhere

research_tool.label: a research and citation tool
research_tool.needs: read the page you are citing and hand it to its desktop app

vpn_proxy.label: a VPN or proxy
vpn_proxy.needs: route your browsing through its network

translation.label: a translation tool
translation.needs: read and replace text on any page

video_tool.label: a video site tool
video_tool.needs: read and adjust the video pages you watch

reading_tool.label: a read-later tool
reading_tool.needs: save the page you are reading

note_taking.label: a note and clipping tool
note_taking.needs: read the page you are clipping

tab_management.label: a tab manager
tab_management.needs: see and rearrange your open tabs

shopping.label: a shopping and coupon tool
shopping.needs: read checkout pages to apply codes

screen_capture.label: a screen recorder
screen_capture.needs: capture the page or screen you point it at

productivity.label: a productivity tool
productivity.needs: add its own controls to the pages you use

browser_agent.label: a browser assistant that acts for you
browser_agent.needs: read the page you are on, click, type and navigate on your behalf, and talk to its desktop app — the whole point of it, and the most access on this list
browser_agent.evidence: Anthropic documents Claude in Chrome acting on pages and explains its debugger, scripting, host, downloads, native-messaging and related permissions.

general_extension.label: a general browser extension
general_extension.needs: read and change the pages you visit, which is what most extensions with site access do
general_extension.evidence: Deliberately plain. The store category does not say what an individual extension legitimately needs, so anything beyond ordinary page access — debugger control, proxying, native messaging, all-site cookies — stays unexpected and is surfaced rather than assumed.
